newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan stocks again close at record high.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan stocks again close at record high.

text.p: Caracas stocks rose to record highs for the third consecutive session on strong foreign bidding, traders said.
The market's 19-share .IBC index gained 1.27 percent to close at 4,864.90 points according to preliminary figures from the stock exchange.
Among traded issues 28 rose, seven fell and six ended flat in strong volume that saw over 17 million shares exchanged to a total value of 3.3 billion bolivars ($7 million).

"Today's was an animated market, mainly on foreign buying," said Financorp broker Hector Perez. "Foreign bids for Electricidad de Caracas were especially strong -- there are rumors of a possible electricity tariff rise," he added.
Market-leader Electricidad, which accounted for nearly one third of the session's trading volume, gained 9.05 bolivars to close at 429.00 bolivars.
